Maya: Quick sync — Acme dedicated pool go-live is this Thurs 09:00 PT. We need final sign-off on quota windows, autoscale rules, and the loadtest plan.
Priya: Got it. I'll confirm billing seat counts and renewal notes by EOD. Renewal risk flag still medium because usage spike might push over reserved commit.
Liam: For autoscale, suggested policy: min=4, target_cp=intended, max=20, scale_cooldown=60s. Want me to post the exact JSON?
Jorge: Yes please. Also share the expected RPS profile so SRE can map to node counts.
Liam: Posting autoscale policy snippet now:
```json
{
  "policy":"cpu_and_latency",
  "min_replicas":4,
  "max_replicas":20,
  "scale_up_threshold":0.75,
  "scale_down_threshold":0.35,
  "evaluation_window_s":30
}
```
Maya: Thanks. Priya can you confirm if Acme will allow burst headroom beyond reserved quota for first 48h? That impacts cost and fallback routing.
Priya: I checked — Acme signed off on a 20% burst margin for first 72h but wants cost alerts at 50% of burst spend. I'll add to the billing playbook.
Evelyn: @Priya pls add renewal note: if 2-week avg consumption > 85% reserved, schedule AE review. We need that as a gating condition before extending commit.
Jorge: Loadtest plan: we'll run three phases — baseline (5m steady), ramp (30m to peak), soak (2h at 80% peak). I’ll attach the k6 script after lunch.
Liam: For the k6 script, use these headers and KV cache warmup step first. Example command:
```
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 30m loadtests/acme_ramp.js
```
Maya: Can we add a canary route to bleed 5% traffic to hosted fallback if latency > 800ms for 3 consecutive minutes?
Jorge: Yes. We'll set a circuit-breaker rule in the routing layer. Config:
`circuit_breaker: {latency_ms:800, window_s:180, fallback_pool:hosted}`
Priya: I'll coordinate enablement call with Acme ops Tue 11:00 PT. Agenda: quota floor, alerts, billing thresholds, rollback steps.
Liam: I'll join and demo autoscale metrics in Redwood Console. Also want to capture their feedback on scale latency.
Maya: Great — action items: 1) Priya: confirm billing alert playbook (EOD). 2) Jorge: push k6 script + RB. 3) Liam: upload autoscale policy to repo. 4) Evelyn: add renewal gating note. We'll reconvene Wed 10:00 PT.
deploy-bot: deploy-triggered: dedicated/pool/acme - config-review passed - ci/1234
Maya: Thanks all. If anything blocks, @Liam or @Jorge flag in this thread. :thumbsup:
